typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{Agency NPN} as string,
		{Agency Name} as string,
		{Agent NPN} as string,
		{Agent Employee Number} as string,
		{Agent Status} as string,
		name_last as string,
		name_first as string,
		name_middle as string,
		{State License Abbreviation} as string,
		{State Name} as string,
		{NAIC Group Code} as string,
		{NAIC Group Name} as string,
		{Company Code} as string,
		{Company Name} as string,
		{Company FEIN} as string,
		{LOA Code} as string,
		{LOA Description} as string,
		{LOA Status} as string,
		{LOA Temination Reason} as string,
		{LOA Status Reason Date} as string,
		{LOA Appointment Renewal Date} as string,
		{LOA County Code} as string,
		{LOA Agency Name} as string,
		{LOA Agency FEIN} as string,
		{Appointment Status} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: true,
	wildcardPaths:['ALMS/alms_*_appointment_*']) ~> source1
source1 filter(((upper({NAIC Group Name}) == 'KAISER FOUNDATION GRP')&&(upper({LOA Status}) =='APPOINTED'))||{Company Name}== 'TTEC Healthcare Solution, Inc') ~> Filter1
DerivedColumn1 select(mapColumn(
		Agency_NPN__c = {Agency NPN},
		Agency_Name__c = {Agency Name},
		Agent_NPN__c = {Agent NPN},
		Agent_Employee_Number__c = {Agent Employee Number},
		Agent_Status__c = {Agent Status},
		name_last__c = name_last,
		name_first__c = name_first,
		name_middle__c = name_middle,
		State_License_Abbreviation__c = {State License Abbreviation},
		State_Name__c = {State Name},
		NAIC_Group_Code__c = {NAIC Group Code},
		NAIC_Group_Name__c = {NAIC Group Name},
		Company_Code__c = {Company Code},
		Company_Name__c = {Company Name},
		Company_FEIN__c = {Company FEIN},
		LOA_Code__c = {LOA Code},
		LOA_Description__c = {LOA Description},
		LOA_Status__c = {LOA Status},
		LOA_Temination_Reason__c = {LOA Temination Reason},
		LOA_Status_Reason_Date__c = {LOA Status Reason Date},
		LOA_Appointment_Renewal_Date__c = {LOA Appointment Renewal Date},
		LOA_County_Code__c = {LOA County Code},
		LOA_Agency_Name__c = {LOA Agency Name},
		LOA_Agency_FEIN__c = {LOA Agency FEIN},
		Appointment_Status__c = {Appointment Status}
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
Filter1 select(mapColumn(
		{Agent NPN}
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Agent
Agent aggregate(groupBy(mycols = sha2(256,columns())),
	each(match(true()), $$ = first($$))) ~> DistinctRows
Filter1 derive({NAIC Group Name} = iif({Company Name}=='TTEC Healthcare Solution, Inc','KAISER FOUNDATION GRP',{NAIC Group Name})) ~> DerivedColumn1
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[(concat('alms_appointment_', toString(currentUTC(), 'yyyyMMdd'), '.csv'))],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> sink1
DistinctRows sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['kaiser_agent.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> KaiserAgent
